title: no min max length names places
name: No min max length names places
rule: No min/max length on names and places — one-character given names and 50-character place names exist. Dual-cite USWDS “raise the DB limit” / character-count not as a cap.

citation.source: NL Design System — Geen min/max lengte

pass_when: Unconstrained name and place fields have no rejecting `minLength`/`maxLength`.
fail_when: `minLength`/`maxLength` rejects a one-character name or a long toponym.
overview: Do not reject names and places with minLength or maxLength caps.
apply_when: Validating given names, family names, or place-name fields.
not_when: Not for passwords or codes that truly need an exact described length.
agent_hint: Leave name and place fields unconstrained by rejecting minLength or maxLength.
description: Do not put rejecting `minLength` or `maxLength` on names and places—one-character given names and fifty-character place names exist. Caps that reject real names or toponyms force people into false answers. Fail when those constraints reject a one-character name or a long toponym. Leave unconstrained name and place fields free of rejecting length limits. Apply when validating given names, family names, or place-name fields.
do_not_claim: Character-count component; USWDS raise-the-cap as a merge.
